requirements.text: Customers should be able to book appointments online 24/7.
Barbers should have the ability to log into the system and manage their own schedules in real time, preventing double bookings.
Automated reminders should be sent to customers via text and email, 24 hours and one hour before their appointments.
The system should provide daily and weekly reports on bookings, cancellations, no-shows, and trends.
Insights into customer preferences and barber performance should be available for better decision-making.
